business_application.capability_rule: capabilities and enterprise entitlements are data-driven; TAGRO currently uses SELL SERVICE STOCK PURCHASE CASH DOCUMENTS PAYMENTS REPORTS; operation names do not invent narrower entitlement codes
business_application.planar_propagation_rule: admitted events hold potential; selected governed vectors carry typed signals; admitted chord contracts combine vectors; passage is mediated and consequential action remains authority-gated
business_application.sweeper_rule: waiting/static vectors and chord candidates are periodically re-inspected according to strength/residency policy; retirement removes static from active circulation without deleting originating events/evidence
business_application.enterprise_user_rule: multiple users may share the same enterprise and material centre while holding independent role and tool-pack assignments
business_application.busy_topology_rule: multiple BUSY nodes may coexist; enterprises bind explicitly by role with optional material-centre and voucher-series mappings; registry stores no BUSY credentials

business_application.closing_cash_rule: enterprise daily money evidence keeps physical cash, noncash receipts, expenses, allocations/contra, deposits/transfers and service receipts distinct; expected physical cash is derived from cash-affecting entries; corrections supersede prior closings
business_application.offline_rule: mobile workflows use authenticated scoped local draft/queue state; database acknowledgement is distinct from local save; network and synchronization states are separate
business_application.stock_truth: COUNT != MOVEMENT != STOCK POSITION != HISTORICAL INFERENCE; missing canonical stock remains unknown rather than zero
business_application.transfer_truth_rule: request dispatch and receipt are separate actor-stamped lifecycle events
business_application.evidence_truth_rule: captured evidence and inference proposals remain separate; proposals require the authority specified by the owning component before consequential use
business_application.sync_truth_rule: offline mutations carry idempotency keys and payload hashes; replays with changed payload are rejected
